name: Serves while talking
hint: Stands still for as long as somebody is talking to it, and says its greeting when they start. Serving comes before errands and a walk home.

name: Fights back
hint: Turns on whoever hit it, whatever it was doing, and on whoever hits it next. Gives up once its target is further off than calm.

name: Hunts on sight
hint: Goes for the nearest of its prey it can see, and turns to a nearer one while it hunts. Gives up once its target is further off than calm.

name: Hunts the weaker
hint: Hunts on sight, but only goes for the nearest of its prey when that one is rated below itself. Once it has started, it keeps after its target whatever the target's rating.

name: Predator
hint: Fights back, hunts what it can see, and keeps to a leash around where it was placed.

name: Returns home
hint: Walks back once it has strayed further than the leash from where it was placed, and stops within near of it. The walk home gives way to anything it starts on the way, a sound included.

name: Investigates noises
hint: Goes to look at a sound it heard, round corners and through walls. Gives up when the source is further off than lose, or after its patience runs out.

name: Casts about when stuck
hint: When everything it was doing has failed, does this for a while and starts over. Its urge is the band being stuck fires at: at need it never interrupts eating, sleeping or a fight, and at roam it interrupts only what the brain holds at idle.

name: Sleeps
hint: Puts itself to sleep with one of its own spells for as long as the condition holds, and wakes when it stops holding. Never sleeps through a fight.

name: Eats when hungry
hint: Goes for food it can see lying about once it is no longer full, and eats it where it lies. Its urge is the band that hunger fires at: at danger it drops a fight for food.

name: Forages
hint: Picks a bush it can see into its bag, out of a fight, and eats what it picked. A body with no bag can stand beside a bush and not touch it.

name: Scavenges
hint: Eats any food it can see lying about, hungry or not, as long as it is out of a fight. A fight takes it off its meal, and a meal never takes it out of a fight.

name: Skittish
hint: Bolts from whoever hits it, and from any threat it can see, until they are safe cells away. Backed into a corner, it holds still, and bolts again the moment it has something to bolt from.

name: Flees the stronger
hint: Runs from the nearest threat it can see when that one is rated at or above itself, and from anybody that rated who hits it, until they are safe cells away. Backed into a corner, it bites, then tries to run again. Call it before fights-back so it runs from a strong attacker instead of turning on them.

name: Flees when hurt
hint: Breaks off and backs away once it is down to this share of its health with the threat still near. Healed, it goes back to what it was doing; clear, it rests.

name: Evades the unreachable
hint: Backs away from anybody who hits it from where it has no way to follow, such as across water or up a ledge, until they are out of sight or it has backed off for a while. Call it before fights-back, or fights-back turns it on them instead.

name: Follows its kind
hint: Tags along after the nearest of its company it can see while nothing else is going on, and loses them past lose. Given settle and stray, it loiters close by and catches up when they get ahead.

name: Townsfolk who flee
hint: Runs from whoever hits it, walks home once they are out of reach or it has run long enough, and snacks with a spell of its own whenever it is not fed and nobody is talking to it. Given a state to listen in, it goes there whenever somebody talks to it, and comes back to rest from a walk home or a snack the same way.

name: Townsfolk who fight
hint: Fights whoever hits it while they stay near and it stays within the leash of home, or for as long as the blows keep landing, heals itself with a spell of its own once it is down to a share of its health, then walks home. Snacks with another spell whenever it is not fed and nobody is talking to it. Turns on whoever it sees strike one of the town, and on anybody wanted that it can see.

name: Raises the alarm
hint: When it sees somebody strike one of the town, it cries out and runs to the nearest guard, then names the culprit, which puts them on the wanted list and sends every guard who hears it after them. Gives up if it cannot reach a guard in time. Keeps clear of anybody wanted that it can see.

name: Keeps the peace
hint: Hunts whoever it is told about, and whoever is wanted that it can see. Seeing somebody strike one of the town itself, it reports them first, so the culprit is wanted and every guard within earshot joins in. Walks back once it is past the leash from home or has lost its quarry.

name: Shelters from rain
hint: Walks out of the rain when somewhere dry is within reach: under a roof or a bridge, down a hole, into a cave, or past where the rain stops. Stays there until the rain overhead ends. Only leaves what it does when idle or roaming.
